svg.title: Beyond mise
svg.desc: Stacked area chart of cumulative GitHub stars since January 2025 for jdx's tools other than mise: 9.34k stars in total, about 1.82k a year earlier. jactionlint 324, mr boxington 743, aube 2068, fnox 2374, hk 1310, pitchfork 714, usage 1075, +6 more 733.

g.text: $ gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/stargazers --paginate # every tool except mise
cumulative stars since Jan 2025, stacked by launch
